key_audit_matters: Revenue recognition: Revenue from sale of goods is recognized when the control of the goods has transferred to the customer and when there are no longer any unfulfilled obligations to the customer. Disclosure Note 23 and the accounting policies provide additional information on how the Company accounts for its revenue in compliance with Ind AS 115.
Revenue recognition: Testing design and operating effectiveness of IT controls, substantive testing of revenue transactions, verification of credit notes, data analytics on manual journal entries
qualifications_or_emphasis: The feature of recording audit trail (edit log) facility was not enabled at the database level to log any direct data changes for the accounting software used for maintaining the books of account.

The company uses payroll software that is managed by a third-party service provider. Upon reviewing the audit reports to verify compliance with audit trail requirements, it was noted that the service organization auditors' report did not provide any opinion regarding the audit trail functionality for the relevant period. Consequently, we are unable to confirm whether the audit trail feature was consistently enabled and operational throughout the year for all relevant transactions. Additionally, we are unable to determine whether there were any instances of the audit trail feature being tampered with.

outlook.statement: Process improvements will continue to be an area of focus to improve efficiencies and reduce cost, work towards more sustainable operations and manufacturing approach, incorporate new technologies to introduce unique product offerings.
Marigold Hybrid Seed Development: continue pre-commercial trials for pipeline hybrids, expand seed production and growing of newly introduced hybrids.

New Product Lines: expand application of newly developed ingredients, generate more data for product range, move from product to solution-based selling, add product lines to new divisions to expand portfolio and market reach.

New Business Segments & Divisions: Animal Nutrition division to remain strategic importance with new product offerings, markets, customers; invest in co-development with strategic partner; develop value added branded ingredients and clinically proven nutraceutical formulations; standardize manufacturing of derma cosmetic ingredients and initiate commercialization.

The Company remains optimistic about its long-term growth prospects, supported by strong momentum in core segments and continued progress in new businesses. Marigold segment to focus on productivity, cost efficiency, and supply stability with expansion into new growing regions, investment in R&D, and phased rollout of hybrid seeds. Spice Oleoresins to focus on expanding global footprint, strengthening value-added portfolio, and maintaining strong compliance. Value-added Tea (Instant Tea) segment remains a key growth driver with plans to deepen customer relationships, expand into new markets, and evaluate capacity expansion. Decaffeinated Tea segment expected to face near-term demand pressures but gradual improvement expected. Animal Health Nutrition division expected to sustain growth with expanding presence across US, Latin America and Southeast Asia. Crop Science division to focus on B2B customers in select International Markets. Company committed to integrating ESG principles across all segments.

The Company responded proactively through pricing adjustments and supply chain optimization to mitigate pressures from tariff changes in the United States which had a significant impact on export realizations and margins.
